description: April 19 birthday meaning: Aries or Taurus cusp, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, April 19 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Aries or Taurus. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: The April 19 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: April 19 usually holds the Sun in the very last degree of Aries, but Taurus season begins so close by that some years and birth times fall on the earth side. Nineteen reduces to 1. The blend pairs fiery initiative with Taurean staying power, describing someone who starts boldly and, unusually for Aries, actually stays the course.

Astronomically, April 19 puts the Sun near 29° Aries in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Jupiter. Born around April 19 or 20, you sit near the line between Aries and Taurus, fire giving way to earth. Which sign your Sun actually occupies depends on the birth year, the time of day and the location, because the ingress moment moves slightly from year to year; a natal chart calculated for your details is the only way to be sure. Traditionally, people on this cusp are said to combine Aries' initiative with Taurus' staying power. That can read as determined and practical, or as stubborn twice over, depending on the day.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for April 19
paragraphs: Born on the 19th, the compound 1 + 9 makes 10, which reduces to 1. The birthday number is therefore 1, reached through the full span of the single digits from first to last. Numerologists sometimes call 19 a karmic debt number associated with learning to accept help. People born on this day are frequently described as fiercely independent, resourceful and determined to do things their own way. The 9 in the compound adds compassion and a broad outlook to the 1's drive. As a secondary number, it tends to reward asking for support without seeing it as weakness.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an April 19 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous April 19 birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 19 is the 109th day of the year (110th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Taurus, is usually complete within 1 day, by April 20.

By April 19 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an April 19 birthday are Ali Khamenei (1939), Maria Sharapova (1987) and José Echegaray (1832).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 19?
faq.answer: April 19 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Aries or Taurus on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Aries. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 19?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 19 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 4 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 19th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 19?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 19, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 19?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on April 19 include Ali Khamenei (1939), Maria Sharapova (1987) and José Echegaray (1832). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
